title: eupatorium squalidum var. subvelutinum
intro: Eupatorium squalidum var. subvelutinum, commonly known as Chinese Eupatorium, is a plant species in the Eupatorium genus. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antibacterial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, pain, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Chinese Eupatorium include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents in Chinese Eupatorium, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
